card.name: Inside all-caps drug and warning words
card.fires_on: Partway through long words written in capital letters, mostly in boxed warnings and brand or drug names. Examples are END-OMET-RIAL, SYN-ARE-L, ROZ-LY-TREK and PRO-GRA-F.

modes.label: Capitalized medical term
modes.description: Middle piece of an all-caps warning heading such as ENDOMETRIAL or EMBRYO-FETAL.
modes.example: ESTROGENS INCREASE THE RISK OF END<<OMET>>RIAL CANCER Close clinical surveillance

modes.label: Capitalized brand or drug name
modes.description: Middle piece of an upper-case brand or generic drug name.
modes.example: resume ROZ<<LY>>TREK at same or reduced dose

card.writes: It promotes capital-letter fragments and suppresses lowercase word endings, so the model keeps spelling in all caps.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long drug names or warning words typed in all capitals.
